baselines.acquisition: the kernel classifier on the acquisition family only
baselines.dinov2s_legacy: the kernel classifier on the old DINOv2-S tile embeddings

provenance_oracle.rule: labels of the training crops from the same source image

single_family.True: in-fold robust scale + PCA <= 16 of the family's non-leakrisk columns

baselines.uniform_sum: the same kernels as A (and B) with equal weights

blind_model.rule: the model (A or B) with the higher balanced accuracy; B if they are within tie_margin_crops correctly classified crops

splits.loco_nbr: leave one crop out and drop its touching neighbours (meta/analysis_only.csv right_neighbour) from training
splits.loso13: leave one source image out (LeaveOneGroupOut over source_image); the headline split

null_a.rule: a random permutation of the batch names inside each source image

null_b.rule: labels shuffled inside the mixed source images only (all arrangements when there are no more than `permutations`)
